 Here's a [basic one](https://github.com/markphelps/flipt/tree/master/examples/basic) to get started!
 
+## Database configuration
+
+Flipt uses SQLite by default. To use Postgres or MySQL, set `db.url` in the
+configuration file or provide separate database settings. A Postgres example:
+
+```yaml
+db:
+  protocol: postgres
+  host: postgres
+  user: flipt
+  password: secret
+  name: flipt
+```
+
+The separate form requires `db.protocol`, `db.name`, and `db.host` (or
+`db.path` for SQLite). Supported protocols are `sqlite`, `postgres`, and
+`mysql`. For SQLite, the path is the database directory and the name is the
+filename. `db.port` and `db.password` are optional. Postgres defaults to port
+5432 and MySQL to port 3306.
+
+Each setting can also be supplied through an environment variable such as
+`FLIPT_DB_PROTOCOL` or `FLIPT_DB_PASSWORD`, which lets deployments inject
+separate secrets. Existing `db.url` and `FLIPT_DB_URL` settings continue to
+work. When a URL and separate settings are both supplied, the URL takes
+precedence.
+

package db

import (
	"database/sql"

	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"
)

const (
	namespace = "flipt"
	subsystem = "db"
)

// statsGetter is an interface that gets sql.DBStats.
type statsGetter interface {
	Stats() sql.DBStats
}

//nolint
func registerMetrics(d Driver, s statsGetter) {
	labels := prometheus.Labels{"driver": d.String()}

	collector := &metricsCollector{
		sg: s,
		maxOpenDesc: prometheus.NewDesc(
			prometheus.BuildFQName(namespace, subsystem, "max_open_conn"),
			"Maximum number of open connections to the database.",
			nil,
			labels,
		),
		openDesc: prometheus.NewDesc(
			prometheus.BuildFQName(namespace, subsystem, "open_conn"),
			"The number of established connections both in use and idle.",
			nil,
			labels,
		),
		inUseDesc: prometheus.NewDesc(
			prometheus.BuildFQName(namespace, subsystem, "in_use_conn"),
			"The number of connections currently in use.",
			nil,
			labels,
		),
		idleDesc: prometheus.NewDesc(
			prometheus.BuildFQName(namespace, subsystem, "idle_conn"),
			"The number of idle connections.",
			nil,
			labels,
		),
		waitedForDesc: prometheus.NewDesc(
			prometheus.BuildFQName(namespace, subsystem, "waited_for_conn"),
			"The total number of connections waited for.",
			nil,
			labels,
		),
		blockedSecondsDesc: prometheus.NewDesc(
			prometheus.BuildFQName(namespace, subsystem, "blocked_seconds_conn"),
			"The total time blocked waiting for a new connection.",
			nil,
			labels,
		),
		closedMaxIdleDesc: prometheus.NewDesc(
			prometheus.BuildFQName(namespace, subsystem, "closed_max_idle_conn"),
			"The total number of connections closed due to SetMaxIdleConns.",
			nil,
			labels,
		),
		closedMaxLifetimeDesc: prometheus.NewDesc(
			prometheus.BuildFQName(namespace, subsystem, "closed_max_lifetime_conn"),
			"The total number of connections closed due to SetConnMaxLifetime.",
			nil,
			labels,
		),
	}

	prometheus.MustRegister(collector)
}

type metricsCollector struct {
	sg statsGetter

	maxOpenDesc           *prometheus.Desc
	openDesc              *prometheus.Desc
	inUseDesc             *prometheus.Desc
	idleDesc              *prometheus.Desc
	waitedForDesc         *prometheus.Desc
	blockedSecondsDesc    *prometheus.Desc
	closedMaxIdleDesc     *prometheus.Desc
	closedMaxLifetimeDesc *prometheus.Desc
}

func (c *metricsCollector) Describe(ch chan<- *prometheus.Desc) {
	ch <- c.maxOpenDesc
	ch <- c.openDesc
	ch <- c.inUseDesc
	ch <- c.idleDesc
	ch <- c.waitedForDesc
	ch <- c.blockedSecondsDesc
	ch <- c.closedMaxIdleDesc
	ch <- c.closedMaxLifetimeDesc
}

func (c *metricsCollector) Collect(ch chan<- prometheus.Metric) {
	stats := c.sg.Stats()

	ch <- prometheus.MustNewConstMetric(
		c.maxOpenDesc,
		prometheus.GaugeValue,
		float64(stats.MaxOpenConnections),
	)
	ch <- prometheus.MustNewConstMetric(
		c.openDesc,
		prometheus.GaugeValue,
		float64(stats.OpenConnections),
	)
	ch <- prometheus.MustNewConstMetric(
		c.inUseDesc,
		prometheus.GaugeValue,
		float64(stats.InUse),
	)
	ch <- prometheus.MustNewConstMetric(
		c.idleDesc,
		prometheus.GaugeValue,
		float64(stats.Idle),
	)
	ch <- prometheus.MustNewConstMetric(
		c.waitedForDesc,
		prometheus.CounterValue,
		float64(stats.WaitCount),
	)
	ch <- prometheus.MustNewConstMetric(
		c.blockedSecondsDesc,
		prometheus.CounterValue,
		stats.WaitDuration.Seconds(),
	)
	ch <- prometheus.MustNewConstMetric(
		c.closedMaxIdleDesc,
		prometheus.CounterValue,
		float64(stats.MaxIdleClosed),
	)
	ch <- prometheus.MustNewConstMetric(
		c.closedMaxLifetimeDesc,
		prometheus.CounterValue,
		float64(stats.MaxLifetimeClosed),
	)
}

item.text: The full offline test suite passes, and the final diff is formatted and clean. I also checked that Postgres and MySQL discrete settings produce DSNs accepted by their drivers; that check did not contact a database server.

Implemented separate database settings in [config.go](/app/config/config.go): a public `DatabaseProtocol` type, field-qualified validation, and URL precedence. [Database connections and migrations](/app/storage/db/db.go) now build the connection target internally, apply the same pool settings in either mode, and redact credentials from errors. Migration calls, documentation, and examples were updated; repeated database opens no longer panic during metrics registration.

Three agents handled configuration, database code, and call sites; I integrated and reviewed their changes. `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./... -count=1` passed. Postgres and MySQL driver parsing was checked without a live database connection.
